title: 2000 AMC 10 Problem 4
statement: Chandra pays an on-line service provider a fixed monthly fee plus an hourly charge for connect time. Her December bill was \(\$12.48,\) but in January her bill was \(\$17.54\) because she used twice as much connect time as in December. What is the fixed monthly fee?

solutions.text:
January doubled only the connect time, so the increase \(\$17.54 - \$12.48 = \$5.06\) equals December’s connect-time cost.

The fixed monthly fee is therefore \(\$12.48 - \$5.06 = \$7.42.\)

Thus, the correct answer is D.
hints: The extra charge in January comes entirely from one additional December’s worth of connect time
The difference \(\$17.54 - \$12.48\) equals December’s connect-time cost
